failure_policy.no_delete: Requests are never deleted during failure handling.
failure_policy.retry: Administrator explicitly sets a retry-approved Pending state after reviewing the error.

idempotency.assignment_key: mp_assignmentkey = lower(email) + ':' + formVersionId prevents duplicate form assignments.
idempotency.audit_key: mp_auditkey uses request id, action, affected email, and form version where applicable.
idempotency.request_key: mp_requestkey alternate key prevents duplicate request rows.

mshirika_smoke_tests: Create a NewUser request from the portal and confirm one queue row starts Pending.
Confirm the Dataverse-triggered flow run appears for the request.
Confirm status changes to Processing and then NeedsReview or Failed.
Confirm NeedsReview NewUser has contact, invitation, audit, and assignments, then verify email delivery or invitation redemption.
Create an ExistingUser request and confirm Dataverse email notification path.
Retry a failed request and confirm no duplicate assignments are created.
Confirm Data Collector cannot read or create mp_onboardingrequest rows.
name: TACATDP - Onboarding Queue Processor

steps.name: Guard_Pending_Status
steps.purpose: Exit without mutation unless request status is Pending.

steps.name: Set_Request_Processing
steps.purpose: Set status to Processing, increment attempts, set LastAttemptAt.

steps.name: Parse_Form_Scope
steps.purpose: Parse mp_formscopejson into selected form-version entries.

steps.name: Find_Contact_By_Email
steps.purpose: Find existing active Power Pages contact by emailaddress1.

steps.name: Create_Contact_When_Missing
steps.purpose: Create contact only when no matching contact is found.

steps.name: Update_Request_Contact
steps.purpose: Write resolved contact id back to the onboarding request.

steps.name: Create_Request_Audit
steps.purpose: Create high-level InviteUser or AssignProject access audit before downstream mutation.

inputs.idempotent_lookup: mp_useremail eq lower(email) and _mp_formversion_value eq formVersionId

steps.name: Apply_Form_Assignments
steps.purpose: For each selected form version, create assignment audit and assignment if missing.

inputs.fallback: manual-code when missing or not tested

steps.name: Find_Notification_Delivery_Setting
steps.purpose: Load singleton onboarding delivery configuration from NotificationDeliverySettings.

steps.name: Route_Email_Delivery
steps.purpose: New users receive native Power Pages invitation; existing users receive Dataverse email notification when a mailbox sender is configured.

steps.name: Create_Native_Power_Pages_Invitation
steps.purpose: For NewUser requests, create adx_invitation bound to contact and site.

steps.name: Determine_Email_Delivery_Readiness
steps.purpose: Email mode is allowed only when configuration says Email and mailbox status is TestedAndEnabled with a sender mailbox.

steps.name: Run_Native_Send_Invitation_When_Ready
steps.purpose: Call native Send Invitation workflow only when delivery configuration is email-ready.

steps.name: Run_Native_Send_Invitation_Workflow
steps.purpose: Execute the native Power Pages Send Invitation workflow only when mailbox delivery is configured.

steps.name: Update_Request_Invitation_Result
steps.purpose: Write invitation id, code, redeem URL, expiry, status, and delivery mode back to the admin-only queue row.

steps.name: Create_Dataverse_Assignment_Email
steps.purpose: For ExistingUser requests, create Dataverse email activity when a mailbox sender is configured.

steps.name: Update_Request_Assignment_Notification_Result
steps.purpose: Write assignment notification delivery mode back to the queue row for existing-user requests.

steps.name: Send_Dataverse_Assignment_Email
steps.purpose: Send existing-user assignment notification through Dataverse SendEmail only when mailbox send is approved.

inputs.existing_user_message: Assignment completed. Dataverse notification email was created but requires mailbox send approval/review.
inputs.new_user_message: Invitation created. If mailbox delivery is not configured, issue the invitation code through an approved internal channel.

steps.name: Set_Request_Needs_Review
steps.purpose: Set status NeedsReview after server-side writes when email delivery, manual code handoff, or invitation redemption cannot be confirmed automatically.

steps.name: Set_Request_Failed_On_Error
steps.purpose: On any processing failure, write Failed status, sanitized error category, and result message.

trigger.operation: When a row is added, modified or deleted
required_privileges: Create/read/write/delete on Callback Registration for the flow owner
Create/read adx_invitation and execute native Send Invitation workflow
Create/send Dataverse email for assignment notifications
